name: Redesign of *765 Guide
dialogues: The *765 Guide was created by the Women's Secretariat of Mexico City to help an observant or the victim in a case of violence against women
They were looking to make it easier to understand and to use on electronic devices
Converted the guide from a brochure on paper to a webpage prototype
Took the challenge of improving the content's guide, putting myself in the position of the pople who needed to quickly remember the guide on violent situations
Reviewed the original content following Rob Waller's evaluation criteria
Sinthesized and reorganized the content, making it easier to understand and less redundant
Showed the content with a bigger font to make it easier to read and using an F-shaped pattern
Redesigned and created pictograms that guarantee visual coherence and faithfully represent the information

images.caption: Transformed from long paragraphs to concise sentences with essential information
